verdicts.reason: A breaks the hierarchy: the RSVP CTA is shrunk into a tiny pill lost among the tag chips, the broken image placeholder is blown up into the largest block on the canvas, the subtitle is squeezed into a narrow four-line ragged column that collides with the date block, and the legal text is unreadably tiny. B uses a sensible left-to-right banner flow (brand and headline, then details and a prominent RSVP button, then the phone) and keeps the brand. Its flaws are a cramped middle column (the 'Reserve a spot' line is jammed under the button, the legal text is illegible), the phone pressed against the top and right edges, and a stray placeholder squeezed beside it.
